policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; ls crates/athena-core/src; sed -n 1,60p crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='crates/athena-core/src/followups.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("use athena_data::JobId;\nuse athena_data::Ladder;\nuse athena_data::records::{AnyRecord, Reference, WorkItemKind};","use athena_data::JobId;\nuse athena_data::records::{AnyRecord, Reading, Reference, WorkItemKind};\nuse athena_data::roles::Ladder;")
s=s.replace("reading: &athena_data::records::Reading,","reading: &Reading,")
s=s.replace('            "Propose these, then queue them as requests",\n','')
s=s.replace('''        assert_eq!(request_text_touches(text), request_text_touches(item));
        assert!(text.contains("Files: records/"), "{text}");''','''        assert_eq!(request_text_touches(text), vec!["records/".to_string()]);
        assert!(text.contains("Files: records/"), "{text}");''')
s=s.replace('''        let word = format!("{}/x runs as its own job", "d".repeat(100));''','''        let word = format!(
            "{}/{} runs as its own job",
            "d".repeat(85),
            "e".repeat(30)
        );''')
s=s.replace('''            assert!(!text.contains(&format!("Original request: try again")), "{text}");
''','''            assert!(!text.contains("Follow up on"), "{text}");
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("pub mod fake;\npub mod gate_counts;","pub mod fake;\npub mod followups;\npub mod gate_counts;")
s=s.replace("//! - [`gate_counts`]:","//! - [`followups`]: the follow-ups an accepted reading's `out_of_scope` list names (\"as its own job\", \"as a\n//!   follow-up request\"), queued once per retry chain as their own steward requests when a job closes;\n//! - [`gate_counts`]:",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("        push_closing_records(&mut closing);\n        let reading_path","        push_closing_records(&mut closing);\n        closing\n            .files\n            .extend(self.follow_up_files(ctx.id(), ctx.reading, ctx.ui));\n        let reading_path",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; cargo fmt --all; cargo build -p athena-core 2>&1 | tail -40
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib followups 2>&1 | tail -60

wc -l crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs && grep -n "^}" crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs | head -20 && grep -n "pub fn intervene\|pub struct InterveneArgs" -A 12 crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs | head -50
grep -rn "Out-of-scope item key\|KEY_LINE\|item key" crates --include=*.rs | grep -v "^crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs" ; grep -n "item key" crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs
git diff crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs | grep -n "let retry = athena"
